status: TRANSLATOR DESIGN EVIDENCE / NOT EXECUTABLE RULE
boundary: This ledger does not change Grammar, Protocol, Composer, or implement translation behavior.

lessons.lesson: Live/self context may supply the affected person; adding PERSON introduces an explicit referent and can change interpretation. Do not encode first person by omission.
Prefer an accepted direct primitive such as food_meat over unnecessary decomposition when it matches the semantic unit.
LESS and DOWN may be alternatives in specified semantic neighborhoods; do not generalize them as globally equivalent.
A general food-shop composition is not automatically a specialized shop taxonomy; select a supported category only when the task/context requires it.
A prohibition should retain the prohibited referent/action when that distinction matters; one location-specific NO message is not universal.
PERSON + FEET supports pedestrian movement in context but does not independently establish a crossing-place relation.
Creator review can correct token order for a specific practical reading; a local order correction is not a general syntax rule.
Arrival-time questions and schedule/timetable requests are distinct; keep the latter unresolved until an exact composition is specified.
